architecture: MiMoV2ForCausalLM (hybrid full/sliding-window GQA, MoE; text stack of the multimodal RL checkpoint)

sources.host_geometry: model-families/mimo26/include/sparkpipe/spark_mimo26_model.h, derived 2026-09-22 from the released config.json, modeling_mimo_v2.py and the safetensors shard headers (ranged header reads - exact dtypes and shapes, not inference)
sources.contract_note: transcribed from the family header and census so tools/generate_recipe.py has one authoritative JSON per served model; the header remains the ground truth the C side compiles against and tests/test_mimo26_census.py binds the two
sources.precision_policy: routed experts MXFP4 (e2m1 weights, e8m0 scales, 32-element blocks) exactly as trained; fp8 e4m3 linear weights with F32 scale_inv per [128,128] block; o_proj, embeddings, lm_head, norms and sink biases BF16 byte-identical to source; router gate and bias BF16/F32 as stored; GEMM accumulation FP32; NO requantization anywhere

hybrid_attention.layer_kind_note: SPARK_MIMO26_MODEL_LAYER_KIND in the family header; sink-bias tensor count 39 equals the SWA layer count

precision.qkv_scale_row_rule: measured per-arm constants (block-128 scale_inv grids; the upstream emitter's row padding is not a clean closed form, so the module and packer pin the measured values: pro 216/216, flash 108/116)

cache.kv_element_source: KV is cached pre-scaled BF16 (value scale folded before the cache write); SWA layers cache 128-token windows only

out_of_scope_regions_v1.note: documented with byte ranges in the census, retained in source, not stripped; the v1 driver serves the non-speculative text tower only
